resources.string: Sets the test voltage and the minimum resistance from table No. 19.1 of RIC No. 19.
Megohmmeter reading, with appliances disconnected and the test voltage applied for one minute.
Commissioning protocol according to RIC No. 19: the tests in the order the standard requires, and the insulation resistance check against table No. 19.1.
In TN the maximum depends on the protective device; in TT the loop impedance must stay below 80 Ω.
B trips at 5 In, C at 10 In and D at 20 In.
Currents from table 19.2.1 of RIC No. 19.
Phase-to-protective-conductor loop tester reading at the farthest point of the circuit.
Checks the measured fault loop impedance against the maximum in RIC No. 19 (220 V phase-to-neutral, tripping in 0.2 s) and calculates the prospective short-circuit current Ipsc = Vn × 1.06 / Zs.
